description: This file defines a serializable state class 'Initialized_State' and a grain class 'InitialStateGrain' that manages a list of names, supporting retrieval and addition operations, as part of an Orleans-based distributed system.

classes.name: Initialized_State
classes.description: A serializable class holding a list of names, used as the state for the grain.

classes.name: InitialStateGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing IInitialStateGrain interface, managing 'Initialized_State' which allows fetching and adding names.

methods.name: GetNames
methods.description: Returns the list of names stored in the grain's state.

methods.name: AddName
methods.description: Adds a new name to the state list and persists the change.
